title: The Office
scene: The licensing office is ahead. You came for the license because the license is the thing that starts the rest of it. Gracie is on the seat. Mya is beside her. There is no line at the door that you can see from here. You have not parked yet. You have not gotten out. You still think the counter is the next thing.
debrief: You came for the license. The cats are with you. The building is the next thing you can see, and that is as far as you understand it.

source.teaching_target: She arrives for the license, still expecting the counter. End before she understands the building.

image_brief.subject: the licensing office ahead through the mesh, not yet parked at the door, both cats on the seat
image_brief.foreground: worn wheel, pink dash, both cats
image_brief.background: low commercial building, doors not yet the subject, wet lot, no lettering
image_brief.read: she is arriving for the license and has not parked
